info.name: SliqDesk API
info.description:
Requests for every endpoint of the SliqDesk API.

1. Start the stack with `docker compose up` (the API is at http://localhost:4000).
2. Open Auth > Log in (seeded users) and send one request. Postman stores the session cookie.
3. Use the other folders. Requests save ids they need (ticketId, memberId, ...) as collection variables.
4. To act as another user, send a different login request.

The folders `Permission checks` and `Isolation check` contain tests: run them with the Collection Runner.
Every response uses the envelope { success, message, data }, which a collection-level test checks on each request.

request.description: Any logged-in user, including one who still has a temporary password. Returns 401 when logged out.
Ends the session and clears the cookie. Safe to call when already logged out.

Any logged-in user. Do NOT run this as a seeded demo user unless you intend to change the documented password (run `npm run seed:reset` to restore it). Use it with a member you added, after logging in with their emailed temporary password.
Superadmin and admin only. Saves the id of the first agent, employee or viewer as `memberId` for the requests below.

Superadmin and admin only. Roles: admin, agent, employee, viewer. A temporary password is emailed (read it in Mailpit at http://localhost:8025). The response never contains it. Saves the new member as `memberId`.
Superadmin and admin only. You cannot change your own role or the owner's.
Superadmin and admin only. Issues a new temporary password, signs the member out everywhere and emails it.
Superadmin and admin only. Removes the member, ends their sessions and unassigns their open tickets. Run `List members` again to pick another one.
Any logged-in user. Newest first. Enable the optional filters as needed. Saves the first ticket as `ticketId`.
Any logged-in user. Staff members (superadmin, admin, agent) who can be assigned tickets. Saves an agent as `assigneeId`.

exec: const pick = list.find(function (a) { return a.role === "agent"; }) || list[0];

request.description: Superadmin, admin, agent and employee. Not viewers. `priority` is optional (low, medium, high, urgent; default medium). A high or urgent ticket starts an SLA clock. Saves the new ticket as `ticketId`.
Any logged-in user, for tickets of their own organization. Other organizations' tickets return 404.
Subject to role rules and valid transitions: open to in_progress, resolved or closed; in_progress to open or resolved; resolved to open, in_progress or closed; closed is final (409).
Admins on any ticket; agents on tickets assigned to them or unassigned.
Admins can assign any staff member. Agents can only claim an unassigned ticket for themselves. Run `List assignees` first to fill `assigneeId`.
Admins on any ticket; agents only on their own tickets.
Any logged-in user, oldest first.
Staff on any open ticket; employees on their own tickets; not viewers; not on closed tickets. A first reply from staff stops the ticket's SLA clock.
